name: Odostamp
subtitle: Mileage Log for Tax Deductions
shortDescription: Stamp each work drive and watch your deduction roll up on a mechanical odometer. Official IRS, CRA, HMRC and ATO rates, with sources shown.
longDescription:
Odostamp is a mileage log for people who drive for work and want the deduction counted properly: freelancers, couriers, tradespeople, sales reps, rideshare and delivery drivers, and anyone claiming business travel.

Each drive you log is a stamp. Every stamp rolls the odometer counter at the top of the screen, so the estimated allowance for your tax year is always one glance away.

### Log a Drive Your Way
- Record live: Odostamp adds up the distance while the screen is open, using Location While Using the App. Only the total is kept; the route itself is never saved.
- Type it in: enter a distance, or the odometer reading at the start and end.
- Mark the purpose, add places and a note, and fix mistakes later.

### Rates From the Authorities
- United States: IRS standard mileage rates, including the mid-year 2026 change, with business, charity, medical and military-move rates.
- Canada: CRA per-kilometre allowance with the first-5,000 km step and the territories bonus.
- United Kingdom: HMRC simplified-expenses rates by tax year, with the 10,000-mile step and motorcycle rate.
- Australia: ATO cents-per-kilometre method with the 5,000 km limit flagged.
The Rates screen shows the date each rate book was read, its version, and a link to the authority page.

### Made for Your Records
- A year report with totals by month.
- CSV export for your accountant or your own spreadsheet.
- Your drives stay on your phone. No account, no sign-up.
whatsNew: First release: live and typed drive logging, rate books for the US, Canada, UK and Australia, year report and CSV export.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
